update.name: glibc
update.summary: Standard Shared Libraries (from the GNU C Library)
update.description: The GNU C Library provides the most important standard libraries used by nearly all programs: the standard C library, the standard math library, and the POSIX thread library. A system is not functional without these libraries.

update.name: glibc-locale-base
update.summary: en_US Locale Data for Localized Programs
update.description: Locale data for the internationalisation features of the GNU C library. This package contains only the U.S. English locale.

update.name: libcurl4
update.summary: Library for transferring data from URLs
update.description: The cURL shared library for accessing data using different network protocols.

update.name: libopenssl-3-fips-provider
update.description: This package contains the OpenSSL FIPS provider.

update.name: libopenssl3
update.summary: Secure Sockets and Transport Layer Security
update.description: OpenSSL is a software library to be used in applications that need to secure communications over computer networks against eavesdropping or need to ascertain the identity of the party at the other end. OpenSSL contains an implementation of the SSL and TLS protocols.
